name: soroauth
initializeCommand: goVersion=$(grep '^go ' go.mod | awk '{print $2}'); nodeVersion=$(node -p 'require("./testdata/gen/package.json").engines.node' 2>/dev/null || node -p 'require("./package.json").engines.node' 2>/dev/null || echo '22.12.0'); rustVersion=$(grep '^channel' rust-toolchain.toml | cut -d'"' -f2); stellarVersion=$(grep -oP 'stellar-cli v\K[0-9.]+' CONTRIBUTING.md 2>/dev/null || echo '28.0.0'); jq -n --arg go "$goVersion" --arg node "$nodeVersion" --arg rust "$rustVersion" --arg stellar "$stellarVersion" '{features: {"ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/go:1": {version: $go}, "ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/node:1": {version: $node}, "ghcr.io/devcontainers/features/rust:1": {version: $rust}}, postCreateCommand: "cargo install --version " + $stellar + " stellar-cli --locked || cargo install --version " + $stellar + " stellar-cli"}' > .devcontainer/generated-devcontainer.json
